newsitem.title: USA: Edison Bros February same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Edison Bros February same store sales up.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said Thursday its same store sales for the four weeks ended March 1 rose 0.5 percent to $59.3 million from $59.0 million in the year-ago four weeks ended March 2, 1996.
Total sales for February decreased $8.3 million, or 11.7 percent, to $62.9 million, compared with total sales of $71.2 million for February 1996.
The company said the decline in total sales was due to a 16.9 percent decrease in the number of stores operated by Edison, which averaged 1,741 during February compared with 2,094 a year ago.
